title: Silent Terror
stack: Angular · Python / FastAPI · MySQL · Docker · Ollama
description: Researching hybrid conversational AI for a social-deduction game by comparing three intent classifiers and three decision-making approaches, with LLM-generated dialogue.
role: Team Lead · Full-stack Developer · AI Researcher

ai.focus: Natural Language Processing · Conversational AI · Game AI
ai.models: SVM · Naive Bayes · Transformer · Behavior Tree · Fuzzy Logic · Utility AI · Qwen3 8B / 14B (Ollama)
ai.approach:
Intent: compare SVM, Naive Bayes, and a Transformer for classifying player chat.
Decision logic: compare Behavior Tree, Fuzzy Logic, and Utility AI for how the NOX bot reacts.
NLG: generate role-aware replies with Qwen3 through Ollama, guided by the detected intent and the chosen decision.
ai.output: NOX bot dialogue shaped by chat intent, decision logic, and game context, with each classifier and decision approach compared side by side.
ai.evaluation: Ongoing research: the three classifiers and three decision approaches are still being compared, so results are not final. Experiments run on local CPU/GPU and through APIs; the silence input is fixed.

title: SkolioCheck
description: Exploring VGG16-based deep learning for scoliosis classification from X-ray images.

ai.focus: Computer Vision · Deep Learning · Medical Imaging
ai.approach:
Convert X-rays to RGB and resize to 224 x 224.
Normalize pixels to 0-1 and run the VGG16-based CNN.
Apply a 0.6 threshold to classify the image.
ai.output: An X-ray classification result: Normal Detected or Scoliosis Detected.
ai.evaluation: Research prototype; verified accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity are not reported.

title: Mushroom Vision
stack: React · Python / Flask · TensorFlow / Keras · OpenCV · scikit-learn
description: Exploring mushroom image classification with handcrafted visual features and a convolutional neural network.

ai.approach:
Resize mushroom photos to 128 x 128.
Extract color, texture, shape, and keypoint features.
Scale the feature vector and classify it with a CNN.
ai.output: Predicted mushroom class, per-image confidence score, and descriptive metadata.
ai.evaluation: Uses HSV, GLCM, Hu, HOG, LBP, and FAST features. Confidence is per prediction; no overall benchmark is reported.

title: Diebety AI Predict
description: Exploring diabetes-risk prediction from tabular data, with interpretable machine learning and SHAP feature analysis.

ai.approach:
Preprocess tabular health data.
Explore Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost.
Explain feature contributions with SHAP.
ai.output: Diabetes-risk predictions from user inputs, delivered through a Streamlit demo.
ai.evaluation: About 90% accuracy reported in the profile; the evaluation split and per-model scores are unspecified.

title: AI Trainer
stack: Python · TensorFlow / Keras · MediaPipe Pose · FastAPI · React
description: Exploring exercise-quality assessment from body poses, using autoencoder reconstruction error to detect deviations from correct movement patterns.

ai.focus: Computer Vision · Deep Learning · Anomaly Detection
ai.approach:
Extract joint angles and summarize five movement statistics.
Train one autoencoder per exercise on correct movements.
Convert reconstruction error into an exercise-quality score.
ai.output: Exercise-quality scores for push-ups, pull-ups, squats, and planks, derived from reconstruction error.
ai.evaluation: Reported MSE: 0.03-0.05, not classification accuracy. Viewpoint and data diversity affect results. MediaPipe in research; MoveNet-style API input. Frontend integration is pending.
